reviews.focus: Inspect every theorem and Audit.lean. reviews.focus: Inspect check.py, generated Examples.lean, validator.py conformance tests, Audit.lean and build. Recommend stronger finite coverage, property-based differential tests, profile fingerprint guards and feasible next verified parsing/refinement boundaries. Actual evidence required; tests in own /tmp scratch only, no production edits.
